description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Oil Pump Seal Gasket and Oil Seal Housing Gasket for the Suzuki 1.3L/8V G13BA Engine.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Pump Gasket
Qty 1 – Front Crank Shaft Gasket (front main seal)
Qty 1 – O-Ring, Dip Stick Guide
Qty 1 – Oil Seal Housing Gasket
Qty 1 – Rear Crank Shaft Gasket (rear main seal)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
